message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend** holidays that Canadians typically enjoy in 2023.  
(“Observed” dates are the ones actually taken off work when the statutory holiday falls on a weekend.)

| Date | Holiday | Observed (if applicable) | Typical long‑weekend span |
|------|---------|--------------------------|---------------------------|
| **Jan 1 2023** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | **Jan 2 2023** (Monday) | **Jan 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Feb 20 2023** (Monday) | Family Day (Ontario, AB, BC, NB, PEI, SK) | – | **Feb 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Apr 7 2023** (Friday) | Good Friday | – | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| **Apr 10 2023** (Monday) | Easter Monday (federal & some provinces) | – | **Apr 8–10** (Sat–Mon) |
| **May 22 2023** (Monday) | Victoria Day (most provinces) | – | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Jul 1 2023** (Saturday) | Canada Day | **Jul 3 2023** (Monday) | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Sep 4 2023** (Monday) | Labour Day | – | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Oct 9 2023** (Monday) | Thanksgiving | – | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Dec 23 2023** (Saturday) | Christmas (Dec 25) | – | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) |

### Notes & Variations

| Province | Extra long‑weekends in 2023 |
|----------|-----------------------------|
| **Ontario** | St. Patricks’ Day (Mar 17) – observed Mar 20 (Mon) → **Mar 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **British Columbia** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) – observed Mar 20 (Mon) → **Mar 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Alberta** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) – observed Mar 20 (Mon) → **Mar 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **New Brunswick** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) – observed Mar 20 (Mon) → **Mar 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Manitoba** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) – observed Mar 20 (Mon) → **Mar 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Saskatchewan** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) – observed Mar 20 (Mon) → **Mar 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Quebec** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) – observed Mar 20 (Mon) → **Mar 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Nova Scotia** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) – observed Mar 20 (Mon) → **Mar 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **PEI** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) – observed Mar 20 (Mon) → **Mar 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) – observed Mar 20 (Mon) → **Mar 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Ontario** | Family Day (Feb 20) – already listed above |
| **Other provinces** | Some provinces observe *Remembrance Day* (Nov 11) as a statutory holiday; if observed on a weekday it can create a short break but not a full long‑weekend. |

> **Quick tip:** If you’re building an app, you can use the `holidays` Python package (`pip install holidays`) to programmatically pull the exact dates for each province:

```python
import holidays
ca_holidays = holidays.Canada(years=2023, prov='ON')  # change prov code as needed
for date, name in sorted(ca_holidays.items()):
    print(date, name)
```

Let me know if you’d like the full list for a specific province or if you need help formatting this data for your app!
